latest.title: Dispatcher training + volunteer app lifts bystander CPR
latest.finding: Bystander CPR before EMS arrival rose from 61.4% to 70.9% (adjusted OR 1.54, 95% CI 1.09–2.19), with no improvement in survival to discharge or neurological outcome

latest.title: Real-time feedback tidies BVM ventilation in arrest
latest.finding: With feedback, insufflated volume fell within guideline range in 68% of ventilations vs 42%, dispersion dropped 35%, and leak volume was 12% lower (mean ratio 0.88); expired tidal volume was unchanged

latest.title: Fatigue common a year after cardiac arrest
latest.finding: Fatigue 35.8%, anxiety 22.6%, depression 18.0%; fatigue exceeded population norms (SMD 0.64) and higher symptom burden tracked with worse EQ-5D, GOSE and return-to-work rates

latest.title: Association Between Capnographic Changes During Pulse Checks of
latest.finding: Shorter pulse checks were linked to higher ROSC (36.3% vs 19.5%; OR 2.39, 95% CI 1.35–4.24) and more favourable ETCO2 loss and recovery patterns
